svg.title: Hux V1-PROOF Harness bundles and run lengths
svg.desc: Route model on the R05 body, cut length for each bundle, connector hardware. Lengths are estimates: cut long, route on the frame, trim, record. Source-checked planning drawing; proposed harnesses and unresolved interfaces require physical verification.
svg.text: Route model on the R05 body, cut length for each bundle, connector hardware. Lengths are estimates: cut long, route on the frame, trim, record.
Rev C | Source: 17 OCT 2026 | Print layout: 17 OCT 2026
17 x 11 in / landscape / 0.5 in margins / print at 100%. Sources and open checks: docs/wiring-atlas.md.
Boards at their R05 centres. Harness runs follow the front cable notches of each deck lane.
wheels and gearmotors hang under the body; pigtails rise to JLEG
Length rule: Manhattan path: board -> front deck notch -> front face -> notch -> board. Cut = path x 1.10 + 2 x 15 mm, rounded up to 5 mm.
Totals: AWG 20 790 mm, AWG 22 2880 mm, AWG 24 9685 mm. Buy about 1.5 m of each.
Pigtail reach check: left motor exit to JLEG = 179 mm Manhattan, pigtail 200 mm. The left pigtail cannot reach the driver board (216 mm). JLEG accepted 2026-10-17.
low_voltage: JST XH 2.50 mm: header B#B-XH-A, housing XHP-#, contact SXH-001T-P0.6 (22-28 AWG)
power: XT30 for the pack, the fuse and the switched rail
motor: Pololu 4752 pigtail keeps its 1x6 0.1 in housing; mates with a 1x6 male header on JLEG
pico_end: Decided 2026-10-17: the user desolders the pre-soldered pins of the Pico 2 and solders the XH headers to the board. The harness plugs into the Pico directly.
wire: 24 AWG signals, 22 AWG for 5 V / 3V3 / motor OUT1-OUT2, 20 AWG for the pack and the rail
Housings: XHP-2 × 15 XHP-3 × 3 XHP-4 × 3 XHP-5 × 4 XHP-6 × 3 B2B-XH-A × 13
Contacts SXH-001T-P0.6: 81 used, buy 106. XT30 pairs: 2. 1x6 0.1 in male headers: 2. Crimp tool: IWISS SN-01BM or Engineer PA-09.
Left: robot LEFT = near wall. The pack lead exit is an assumption; measure the pack. Button leads are fixture runs (600 mm).
